'''Deretta''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the staging point of the [[Deretta Destroyers]], a mixed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], until their destruction prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
